title: Training Plan
description: The slide-by-slide build plan. Stage 2 writes the module outline, learning objectives and topic map; Stage 3 fills in content, images, diagrams and questions; Stage 4 builds from it; Stage 5 audits against it and the source index.

source_index_ref.description: Path to the source_index.json this plan draws on

system.description: The system being trained on, in the client's own words

release.description: Build or release the material describes — training goes stale against a moving system

learning_objectives.description: Written before any slide is selected. Observable and task-shaped ('raise a PO against a blanket agreement'), never 'understand the PO module'.

deferred_topics.description: Topic IDs from the source index deliberately not taught, each with a reason. A topic that is neither taught nor listed here fails Stage 5 — dropping content has to be a decision, not an oversight.

excluded_assets.description: Placement-class assets deliberately not used, each with a reason (duplicate, superseded screen, unusable resolution). Same rule as deferred topics: a screenshot cannot be silently dropped.

limit.description: A session-length cap, where one is set

title.description: Learner-facing title, using the system's own screen and transaction names verbatim

objective_ids.description: Objectives this module serves. Union across modules must cover every LO.

audiences.description: Recorded but IGNORED by the v0.1 build. Reserved so audience curation (v0.2) is a renderer flag rather than a schema migration and a re-run.

layout.description: Layout name from template_profile.json — must exist in the template

speaker_notes.description: Trainer-facing. On a knowledge-check slide the answer key is generated into the notes from the question blocks — do not hand-write answers onto the slide.

placeholder.description: Placeholder name from the template profile

kind.description: 'steps' and 'callouts' take arrays of strings and render numbered, so a screenshot's callouts sit beside the image rather than being burned onto it. 'questions' takes the knowledge_check question array. Use 'text' for placeholders the layout already wraps in an element of its own.

content.description: String for prose, array for bullets/steps/callouts/questions, object for table/image/diagram.

sources.description: Source-index anchors this content came from. MUST be non-empty unless gap is true — no third state. A diagram carries the anchors of the text it was drawn from: an interpretation without a citation is exactly what this pipeline exists to prevent.

gap.description: True when the documents do not cover it. Renders as a visible [GAP] marker; never substitute generated filler. On a business rule, a [GAP] means the spec does not say — a question for the process owner, not a sentence for us to write.

gap_note.description: Required when gap is true — what is missing and which objective it leaves exposed

asset_id.description: image blocks — the source-index asset placed here

asset_path.description: image blocks — path to the original bytes; embedded as a data URI by the HTML renderer, inserted as a picture on the .pptx path

diagram.description: diagram blocks — Mermaid source is the stored form: reviewable, diffable and regenerable. The HTML target renders it client-side; the .pptx target rasterises it via render_diagram.py.

rendered_path.description: Set by render_diagram.py for the .pptx path

questions.description: questions blocks — exactly 5, mixed mcq and true_false. See knowledge_check.schema.json.
